title: Zombie Bundle: Deploy Skew & IndexedDB Corruption
description: Step through how a live deploy splits HTML, ESM chunks, bfcache snapshots, and IndexedDB schema versions across open tabs.

steps.label: 1. Service Worker & HTML Skew
steps.description: Deploy v2 lands on the CDN. Tab A still runs v1 under the active Service Worker while Tab B loads v2.
steps.codeHighlight: // sw-v1.js still serves cached index.html (referencing chunk-v1.js)

steps.label: 2. HTTP Cache & Missing Chunks
steps.description: Tab A navigates lazily. Cached index.html requests chunk-8f2a.js, which CDN v2 purged, or mixes immutable v1 modules with v2.

steps.label: 3. Live ESM Binding Mismatch
steps.description: Where v1 modules remain in the module map, live ESM bindings expose old state shapes to newly fetched v2 helpers.
steps.codeHighlight: export let schemaRev = 1; // stale live binding read by v2 consumer

steps.label: 4. bfcache + Schema Bump
steps.description: Tab B upgrades IndexedDB to v2. User hits Back in Tab A: bfcache restores the frozen v1 JS heap without firing a network check.

steps.label: 5. Silent IndexedDB Corruption
steps.description: The zombie v1 runtime in Tab A writes v1-shaped records into the v2 object store, bypassing migration invariants.
steps.codeHighlight: store.put({ id: 42, legacyPayload: '...' }); // corrupts v2 index
